# Cybersikkerhed er en megatrend - disse aktier satser investorer på

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-11-12  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Euroinvestor Millionærklubben episode features Snowball Invest manager Henrik Sparup and eToro popular investor Christian Jane Kongsted (CPH Equities). Both are bullish on cybersecurity, which they see as a long-term winner from AI growth, data volumes and regulation, though valuations are stretched. Both saw the post-US-midterm tech sell-off as sentiment-driven and bought the dip in AI and chip stocks. They also discussed the Nvidia CEO scandal as a possible entry point and the upcoming Anthropic IPO.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Henrik (guest) sees the CEO-scandal drop as a fine entry point with an ultra-low P/E and asymmetric risk. Christian (guest) is close to buying but waiting.

#### Reasoning

Nvidia holds ~90% of the GPU market and forward P/E is ~10 (about 8 two years out). No data shows growth slowing. Henrik: if the multiple holds, returns could be ~60% a year. Christian agrees long-term but expects more downside if Huang leaves. The Singapore chip-routing issue is still unresolved.

#### Sell Triggers

- further multiple contraction
- evidence of slowing growth or disappointing earnings
- Singapore chip-export/spy case reveals fundamental damage
- Jensen Huang departure triggers deeper sell-off

> *"i min verden, så hvis det ikke er en købsmulighed, så ved jeg ikke, hvad der skulle være en købsmulighed."*

---

### 🟢 PANW — Palo Alto Networks | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Christian (guest) holds ~4% after his algorithms picked it. Henrik (guest) owns it as the network-security platformization winner.

#### Reasoning

It has the best one-stop security platform with cross-selling and sticky subscriptions. It already has quantum-safe encryption and got early access to Anthropic's Mythos model. The cybersecurity market should be much bigger in 5-10 years. Valuation is high and sensitive to interest rates.

#### Sell Triggers

- sharply rising interest rates compress long-duration valuations
- narrative shift back to AI disrupting security software
- loss of platform leadership

> *"mine algoritmer, som jeg selv har defineret, udpeger Palo Alto som det bedste bud"*

---

### 🟢 CRWD — CrowdStrike | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Henrik (guest) holds it as the most dynamic, AI-centric and fastest-growing of his three cyber picks. Christian (guest) calls it a super strong case.

#### Reasoning

It has grown revenue 20-30% a year for years and 20-25% is expected going forward. It kept customers after its outage and is one of two firms given early access to Mythos. Forward P/E is ~180, so it is priced for perfection. Henrik trimmed for technical reasons and would add on dips of 30% or more.

#### Sell Triggers

- rising rates
- growth falling below 20%
- another major software failure causing customer loss
- valuation de-rating

> *"Så jeg synes, begge de to virksomheder er super, super stærke bud."*

---

### 🟢 FTNT — Fortinet | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Henrik (guest) holds it as the cheap, most profitable value play focused on small and mid-size firms. He welcomed its 30% drop on a small miss as a chance to buy.

#### Reasoning

It is a large network-security player and the cheapest of the three with the highest profitability, though its value proposition is weaker than Palo Alto's. Henrik uses dips driven by small misses to build the position long-term.

#### Sell Triggers

- persistent service revenue misses
- losing SMB network-security share

> *"Men jeg elsker sådan noget, fordi hvis jeg tror på det på den lange bane, så er det jo bare penge, jeg kan samle op på gaden."*

---

### 🟢 MU — Micron | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Christian (guest) bought after it fell 15% on 5 Nov, calling it an overreaction.

#### Reasoning

Micron is sold out through 2027 and partly 2028, so a slower AI rollout after the midterms matters little. He sees the sell-off as driven by options and index rebalancing, not fundamentals.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI demand weakens
- regulation materially slows datacenter rollout

> *"det der er jo sagen for både TSMC og Micron, det er, at de har fuldstændig udsolgt på alle hylder i 27"*

---

### 🟢 TSM — TSMC | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Christian (guest) bought the dip. It had its best quarter ever (+60% y/y). Henrik (guest) calls it a monopoly with ~95% of leading-edge chips.

#### Reasoning

Demand is extremely strong and capacity is sold out for 2027. Both guests see the sell-off as sentiment-driven.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI capex slowdown
- political backlash against datacenters escalates

> *"Så efter min mening, en kæmpe overreaktion fra markedet, og derfor købte jeg op i de tre aktier."*

---

### 🟢 AMD — AMD | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Christian (guest) bought during the capitulation on 5 Nov; up 36% since.

#### Reasoning

This was a contrarian buy into what he called a forced, sentiment-driven AI sell-off, with demand intact.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI demand fundamentals deteriorate

> *"Og AMD er alene oppe 36 procent, siden jeg købte i torsdag."*

---

### 🟢 META — Meta | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Henrik (guest) bought during the tech sell-off.

#### Reasoning

He uses volatility to add to long-term convictions, keeping cash in reserve for moments like this.

#### Sell Triggers

- long-term thesis breaks

> *"Så jeg har været køber af Meta og Mercado Libre"*

---

### 🟢 MELI — Mercado Libre | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Henrik (guest) bought after a sharp drop on a marginal earnings miss.

#### Reasoning

He sees the reaction to a small miss as excessive and an opportunity to add for the long term.

#### Sell Triggers

- repeated earnings misses indicating fundamental decline

> *"Mercado Libre, som også tog en ordentlig tur, til trods for et helt marginalt mis på earnings"*

---

### 🟠 ANT — Anthropic | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

IPO subscription starts today and trading is expected late next week under ticker ANT. Christian (guest) is considering buying because the price range was lower than expected. Henrik (guest) is selling his indirect stake at the IPO.

#### Reasoning

Christian is a heavy user of its products and sees them as a new operating system for work. Henrik thinks it has a high chance of winning the LLM race but the winner is not yet clear, so it does not fit his strategy. Statistically, IPOs tend to underperform over time.

#### Sell Triggers

- IPO priced too high
- LLM race shows no clear winner
- AI-theme turmoil worsens

> *"Jeg overvejer det, og jeg er faktisk ikke helt færdig med mine overvejelser"*

---
